AI Boom Drives 19-Fold Surge in 'Forward Deployed Engineer' Jobs in India

Job postings for the role of 'Forward Deployed Engineer' (FDE) in India have seen a 19-fold increase, a surge of 1,807%, driven by the artificial intelligence boom. According to Glassdoor data updated in January 2026, the average base salary for an FDE in India is approximately ₹12 lakh per year, with a reported range of ₹9 lakh to ₹16 lakh, based on 28 submissions.
